diabolik-01-inafferrabile-criminale.cheats:
DIABOLIK SOLUTION 1 – THE ELUSIVE CRIMINAL
In the Turner Bonk level, go through theVENTILATION DUCTS, forcing the hatch open withACID.
In the 3rd forest screen, locate the exit from the cliff that iscamouflaged like a branchamong the trees, on thelowest platform. ALMOST ALL THE “EXITS” ARE CAMOUFLAGED THIS WAY.
Remember, to successfully perform aLONG JUMP, you must first get arunning start, i.e., JUMP ONLY AFTER TAKING A STEP (in the PC version, for example, to do a long jump to the right, PRESS KEY 3 AND THEN IMMEDIATELY 9 ON THE NUMERIC KEYPAD).
The correct sequence to activate the control columns is:THIRD, FIRST, SECOND, FOURTH.
At the FORK in the road, you must decide whether to head toward theCONTROL TOWERSor theBUNKER— the fork is on THE SCREEN TO THE LEFT OF THE ONE WITH THE OVERTURNED JEEP.
To disable theALARM CONTROL, use theKNIFEto force open the panel, and then again with the KNIFE, cut theTHIN PLASTIC-COATED WIRE.
Thebunker doorcan only be openedafter activating the control towers in the correct order.
In the armored bunker, in the room with five doors, enter theSECOND ONE.
To avoid losing energy in thetrap room inside the armored bunker, refer carefully to theMAPfound on thethird page of the coverof issue no. 1 of the INTERACTIVE GAME.
MAY THE JOYSTICK BE WITH YOU – SEE YOU NEXT MONTH(Andrea Bradamanti – Lead Tester)

diabolik-04-trappola-dacciaio.name: Diabolik 04: Trappola D'Acciaio
diabolik-04-trappola-dacciaio.cheats:
DIABOLIK SOLUTION No. 4 – STEEL TRAP
Remember that to successfully make a LONG JUMP, you need to get Diabolik a running start — that is, ONLY JUMP AFTER TAKING A STEP FORWARD. Be careful, because inside the museum there are deadly robot guards armed with lethal electric shocks.
1. Head toward the room labeledBOILER; to find the entrance to the museum, all you need to do isINTERACTwith the boiler and, during the animation, use theCROWBARon theFLUE PIPE.
Once inside, go to the room labeledROPE.
Here you’ll find a rope that will be useful later.
2. Next, your task is to steal the 3 treasures of the museum, which are:
A) CROWN(room: CROWN): Carefully examine the floor, then use theCROWBARon the floor to disable a trap. After that, use theACIDto eliminate an alarm located on the pedestal.
B) STATUE(room: STATUE): Examine the wall and use theSUCTION CUPSon it; this will allow you to steal the statuette.
C) PAINTINGS(room: PAINTINGS): Use theACIDon the frames, being careful not to trigger the traps.
3. Great, most of the job is done; now all that’s left is to head toward the museum convoy (room:TRAIN) andJUMP ONTO IT...
This willEND THE FIRST PART OF THIS WONDERFUL ADVENTURE...

diabolik-05-ore-pericolose.name: Diabolik 05: Ore Pericolose
diabolik-05-ore-pericolose.description: Manual scans courtesy of Diego Iena (Italian contributor)
diabolik-05-ore-pericolose.cheats:
Have you been breaking your brain for hours? Trained for years and still couldn’t finish the previous episode? This page is for you!
Let’s pick up whereDiabolik is on the roof of the train, where he took refuge after escaping the Clerville museum.
Diabolik must move through the train cars and reach the locomotive to stop the train and jump off. Along the way, he mustkill every guardhe encounters.
Midway through, acutscenewill trigger (PC/Amiga) where Diabolikduels with a guard— you’ll need to kill him.
Once at thelocomotive, Diabolik will enter the cabin, starting another cutscene with along dialogue between him and the train engineer(PC/Amiga).
Whatever dialogue choices you make,Diabolik will dive into the river, where he hides theloot stolen from the museum.
Click the pointer in the following sequence:
TOP-RIGHT → BOTTOM-RIGHT → TOP-RIGHT → BOTTOM-RIGHT → BOTTOM-RIGHT
Diabolik will end up in front of ajeep, which he must examine tosabotage the radioandslash a tire.
Now, click on theright side of the screen, where anarmed soldierappears. Doeverything he sayswithout revealing where the loot is hidden — that gives him a reason tospare your life.
Diabolik must also say:"YOU'D KILL ME ANYWAY!"The guard will walk away to get reinforcements.
Diabolik is lefttied to a tree, thinking about how to escape.Help him by clicking the pointer on thetablenearby. Delighted by your choice, Diabolik willkick the table, knocking it over andbreaking a bottleon it.
Now, click the pointer on theglass shards, so that Diabolik cancut his ropesand free himself.(This entire animation is PC-only.)
Head toposition 2, where Diabolik finds himself in front of aninhabited house— you’ll need to interact with it.
A cutscene plays where Diabolik asks ayoung manif he can come in tohide from the guardschasing him. The boy lets him in.
Diabolik orders the boynot to say he saw him. Sure enough, thepolice question the boy, but he says nothing.
Once the police leave the house, the boy reveals asecret exit, through which Diabolikcan escape.(This cutscene contains several dialogue options, butall lead to Diabolik’s escapethrough the secret exit.)
Go toposition 3, where you’ll find acomputerto interact with, triggering acutscene.In the animation, Diabolik must work at the monitor todeactivate areashe otherwise couldn’t reach.He needs to use the"CITY NAME":GREENWICH.That area is now deactivated.
Head toposition 4, where you’ll encounteranother computer.A cutscene similar to the previous one will play, but this time Diabolik must enter"DECIMAL VALUES"in the following sequence:0 – 514706 –Then enter theCITY NAME:GREENWICH.That area is now deactivated too.
Proceed toposition 5, where Diabolik’s movement triggers acutscene.Asoldier jumps out from the bushes— and Diabolik kills him.He hears a noise and quicklysearches the soldier, finding ascrewdriver.The noise? Just a rabbit.
Now move toposition 6, where there’s yetanother computerto interact with.A cutscene starts: Diabolik is at the monitor butcan’t use the keyboard, so he decides to disable the system.(You’ll be presented with a set of choices.)
Choose to use the screwdriver.This will deactivate thelast restricted area.
Finally, head toposition 7.A cutscene will play where Diabolik finds himself in front of awell, and withGinko’s guards right behind him, he has no choice but tojump into escape.
Dear friends, I’m completely worn out… I feel like Zootbruot, my alien friend, so...
...happy interaction and hasta la vista!

diabolik-06-la-notte-della-paura.name: Diabolik 06: La Notte Della Paura
diabolik-06-la-notte-della-paura.cheats:
DIABOLIK SOLUTION NO. 6 - THE NIGHT OF FEAR
Dear simulated thieves, I know you are very eager to interact with Èva Kant and, perhaps because of this, you can't free Diabolik who is currently hanging in the void of a well. He could climb back up and look for another refuge, but it’s much better if he jumps toward an opening and ends up in the Ghenf sewer network.
ARCADE:
Head to position no. 1 where you will find a key that will help you open the gate at position no. 2. Now go to position no. 3 and you will find a ladder to interact with to help Diabolik climb onto the street.
ANIMATION:
Diabolik will hear the voices of some approaching policemen and must make a sprint worthy of the fastest feline to avoid being seen.
Diabolik understands he needs to repair his radio watch (which he had broken earlier) to communicate with his Èva and ask for help. He absolutely must find a watchmaker!
Towards position no. 4, he will find a relative (drunk) of the watchmaker’s owner who, when threatened, will give him the keys to the workshop.
Now Diabolik must go to position no. 5 (the workshop) and enter it using the stolen key.
ANIMATION:
Diabolik manages to repair the radio watch and communicate with Èva, but here comes the workshop owner who, despite his old age, manages to corner our hero with a gun. Diabolik starts a dialogue with the old man and must notice the best moment to free himself. Be careful not to hit the old man directly, as the gun is well aimed.
As soon as Diabolik frees himself, run towards position no. 6 until reaching an abandoned villa with a large terrace.
ARCADE:
Head to position no. 7 and communicate with Èva.
ANIMATION:
Ginko has surrounded the villa with his men and gives Diabolik 10 minutes to leave; Èva advises Diabolik via radio to reach the roof because she already has a plan. Diabolik must head to the roof, and an animation will trigger.
FOR AMIGA:
After communicating with Èva, reach position no. 9 and you will finally be on the roof, but here comes Ginko’s helicopter and... this too will be a surprise ending.
My dear interactive Bluebeards, see you next month.

diabolik-07-4-diamanti-unici.name: Diabolik 07: 4 Diamanti Unici
diabolik-07-4-diamanti-unici.cheats:
Dear friends, haven’t you managed to find the thread of our adventure?Maybe you need a simulated Ariadne’s thread?Or maybe you just need my help!
Diabolik is in the castle park and must find a way to get inside:Go toposition 1and interact with the lever;Then go toposition 2and interact with the statue.
Decide to examine it by clicking on various parts until you find a key;Do the same atposition 3and with all the other statues you find in the park.
Once you have collectedall the keys, enter the castle through thesecret dooratposition 4.
After entering, proceed toposition 5and interact with the iron cabinet.Go toposition 6and do the same with the nightstand next to the bed.
Run toposition 7and interact with the piano.Then, atposition 8, interacttwicewith the lever to climb the stairs.
Continue toposition 9and repeat the interaction with another lever, so that atposition 10a secret entrance will open.
Along the way, keep your eyes wide open, because it’s very easy to fall into traps.
Good luck!

diabolik-08-un-piano-perfetto.name: Diabolik 08: Un Piano Perfetto
diabolik-08-un-piano-perfetto.cheats:
DIABOLIK SOLUTION NO. 8 – A PERFECT PLAN
Ladies and gentlemen of the interactive world, welcome to the page for the latecomers. I had hoped that, as time went on, fewer and fewer people would need to read this page. Instead, it’s becoming more and more important with each passing month.
The secretary catches you as you enter the castle, but you discover that she, too, wants to steal the diamonds. So why not work together?! Go back to Èva and convince her that the best solution is to carry out the heist with the secretary.
Time for action. You're at the ceremony and receive a message: “As soon as the opening speech begins, enter through the large door.”
Remember that you're wearing the mask of a real person, so it’s best not to talk to anyone to avoid contradictions. Unfortunately, a collector recognizes you, thinking you're an old friend. Cut the conversation short and try not to talk about memories. Now move on to action:
Look for the room with the display case where the diamonds are kept, look inside the helmet of the armor and take the oil; go to the room where the sword is stuck in the stone, oil it and pull it out; interact with the second drawer of the nightstand and press the button; enter the adjacent room, interact with the cabinet, take the infrared goggles and check the positions of the light beams in the diamond room; go back to the cabinet and deactivate the first dial. Now you can steal the diamonds. Once done, exit through the only door you haven’t used yet.
ARCADE:
Go to position 1 and take the key on the table; go to 2, take the key on the wall and proceed to positions 3, 4, and 5; interact with the armor and crawl to position 6; take a third key and crawl back; reach position 8 and interact with the lever; now go to position 9 and...
... Good luck!

diabolik-09-a-caro-prezzo.name: Diabolik 09: A Caro Prezzo
diabolik-09-a-caro-prezzo.cheats:
DIABOLIK SOLUTION NO. 9 – AT A HIGH PRICE
Good day to you, dear interactive fans who live off simulated dreams within the wonderful Simulmondo. We've reached the tenth issue of these simul-adventures, and more and more readers have asked us to expand the technical–informative section of the booklet. Therefore, starting this month, the solution pages have become two, and the "info" pages three.
After a brief but necessary introduction, let’s get to the heart of the matter:
Diabolik is in the forest just outside thecastle (slide 1), and he must try to free Èva.
Head toroom 1 (slide 2)
to be able to proceed toroom 2; a map of the area will appear.
Click on the "hideout"—a screen with the hideout-laboratory environments of Diabolik will appear (slide 3):
interact with the table (slide 4),
take the magnifying glass and the photograph (slide 5), and look closely at the detail of the hand.
Diabolik will remember the transmitter watch and contact Èva; from the information received, he will understand that Èva is at the Lido of Ghenf.
Open the first drawer and take the binoculars.
Leave that room and click on the wardrobe you'll find(slide 6):
open the first door and take the baron's mask;
leave the room and the hideout; reach the map (slide 7) and click on the police station.
Try to mislead Inspector Ginko’s investigation (slide 8) as Èva advised:
you’ll need to talk about the dead secretary, the butler, and the injured policemen.
Return to the map and click on the promontory (slide 9):
observe the distant houses and try to discover in which one Èva has been locked up (slide 10).
Go back to the map and click on the Lidos of Ghenf: you’ve reachedroom 2 (slide 11),
now you’ll have to reachroom 3 (slide 12)and enter the house.
Once inside, strike the baron hard, take the diamonds, and escape with your Èva.
Your trusted VS. tester

diabolik-10-allultimo-sangue.name: Diabolik 10: All'Ultimo Sangue
diabolik-10-allultimo-sangue.cheats:
DIABOLIK SOLUTION NO. 10 – TO THE BITTER END
I see that as the “King of Crime,” you’re not quite as clever as you’d like to make people believe. In fact, if you’re reading the solution once again, it means that Simulmondo’s adventures are still not as easy to solve as some of you claim. After all, I’m here specifically to help you, and, as if that weren’t enough, I try to make each solution clearer than the last. In short, I’m doing my best, so if something doesn’t satisfy you—write, write...
Diabolik is talking with his Èva, who tells him how full of money Fischer’s gambling den safe might be. The two plan a way to pull off the heist. Consider Èva’s advice: enter the house wearing a mask. Once the dialogue ends,
enter thelab (slide 1)
and choose the knife from theavailable weapons (slide 2);
take the acid from the wardrobe and exit.
The map will appear:
click on thegambling den (slide 3).
You’re now in front of the house: click on the front door;
enter the house and stash your clothes in a closet.
Go toroom 1 (slide 4),
enter it, and forcefully open the desk drawer:
take thekeys inside (slide 5)and leave;
head toroom 2 (slide 6), in the study,
take thebook (slide 7)and place it in the empty slot on the bookshelf.
Examine the desk lamp and move it: now click with your hand on the hidden opening in the bookshelf and
open thesafe (slide 8)
by clicking on it with the hand icon.
Inside, you’ll find a curious note.
Exit the house and, once the map appears, click on Fischer’s villa:
a dialogue with him begins; he’ll make you an offer—to sabotage the casino ship *Airone*, Fischer’s competitor.
Accept the offer;
go to the map, click on the hideout, and tell Èva everything.
Now click on the *Airone* ship.
You’re inroom 4 (slide 9);
head toroom 5and enter(slide 10):
examine the pocket of thehanging jacket (slide 11)
and take the magnetic card;
leave and go toroom 5:
interact with the electrical panels in thewall (slide 12);
enter the cabin and... enjoy the interaction.

diabolik-11-inganno-fatale.name: Diabolik 11: Inganno Fatale
diabolik-11-inganno-fatale.cheats:
Solution - Diabolik 11
Here we are again with the solution to the mysterious interactive thriller of Diabolik. You’ve surely enjoyed your holidays and probably took a nice break from your computer. Fresh as ever, let’s start right away to figure out the many puzzles that “the designers” have included in the summer episodes.
Diabolik has a conversation with his Èva, during which he must decide which strategy to adopt: you choose the plan with the motorboat and ignore Èva’s advice. Diabolik must now go to his laboratory to get the dagger (among the weapons) and the anchor (among the heavy tools)
(slide 1)
Exit and go to the map: click on the hideout and you will find a motorboat ready for you
(slide 2)
After a short trip
(slide 3)
You will reach the Airone and can board it. Click on the ship’s deck to enter the Arcade section.
Diabolik must go to the engine room (room 2), passing through room 1 to look for the control panel :
(slide 4)
cut the bundle of cables coming from the control panel itself (slide 5) and switch the position of the main lever.
(slide 6)
Now Diabolik must go to room 3, the office with the computer turned on on the desk.
(slide 7)
Click on the computer, then on the wordCODESand then onSAFE.TXT. A file will appear showing you the safe’s combination (26041971).
Now Diabolik can start searching for the safe’s office: pass through room 4 and interact with the panel, then go to room 5 where you will find the safe, Èva, and Fischer. Diabolik will have a conversation with both. First, he must talk to Èva....
(slide 8)
....then to Fischer. At the end of the dialogue, click on the safe and, using the previously discovered code, open the door.....
(slide 9)
......and take the money.
Diabolik will then leave with Èva on the motorboat.....
(slide 10)
.........while the Airone is blown up by Fischer.

dragons-lair.description: [1]Original game designby Rick Dyer andgameplay designVictor Penman, Marty Foulger and Darlene Waddington.Main codingby Randy Linden;additional codingby Andy Thut, David Foster and Mark Vange.Background graphicsby Pat Kushko and Larry Chase;animationsby David Brimblecombe, Bernard Hellreich, Raymond Liu, Mike Nuke, Jim Pun, Victor Sue, Kenneth Tam and Alex Tanchez;rotoscopingby Andy Blau, Mark Vange and Randy Linden;video digitisingby Andy Blau and Mark Vange;video compressionby Randy Linden.Audio synchronisationby David Foster and Randy Linden;audio compressionby Mark Vange;audio digitisingby Randy Linden and David Foster.[2] Consistent with other 16-bit computer platforms (Atari ST, Macintosh, PC) at that time, the Amiga conversion of the laserdisc coin-op DRAGON'S LAIR was split into two game releases: DRAGON'S LAIR (PART I) andDRAGON'S LAIR: ESCAPE FROM SINGE'S CASTLE.[3] Curiously, DRAGON'S LAIR supports hires screenmodes (simply press the 'H' key) - albeit without sound during gameplay! The game also supports interlace mode - but without sacrificing sound - as well as low pass audio filtering (for improved sound on some A500/2000 systems). According to thegame manual:'H – Switch High Resolution mode on and off. ln High Resolution mode, the picture is condensed and centered in the middle of the screen. To see your Amiga reach new heights of graphic excellence, switch to this mode! Audio is disabled while high resolution mode is active.I – Toggle interlace mode on/off. Interlace mode will double the number of lines displayed on your monitor thus eliminating scan lines and improving image quality. This may, however, cause flicker on some monitors.A - Toggle Audio on and off.L - Toggle Low Pass filter on and off. This improves sound quality on some A500’s and A2000’s.'

dragons-breath.name: Dragons Breath / Dragon Lord
dragons-breath.description: [1] Distributed in Australia byMindscape. Distributed in France and translated to French bySilmarils. Distributed in Germany and translated to German byAriolasoft.[2] The little-known Turkish and Italian releases are extremely hard to find and receive a rarity rating of 4 stars.Last known release:V1.0 (1990)TRIVIA–In an overview of DRAGON LORD on his website, coderAndrew Baileyhad these memories to share about the game in looking back on its development:'The game almost didn't make it because of hardware (hard disk) failure. The game was developed on an Amiga 2000 with a PC-XT bridge board providing the hard disk support. One day, after much time had passed since a backup, the hard disk just failed and many hours of rebooting didn't bring it back up. So I went on a long walk and resigned myself to a long session re-coding. When I got home, I powered up the Amiga once more and the hard disk magically whirled into action. I quickly went and bought 50 floppy disks and backed up the hard disk. The hard disk didn't fail again, but I learnt my lesson and have been a backup fanatic ever since.Because the game was developed on the Amiga, the artwork was developed with its capabilites in mind. This meant each screen could not use more than 32 colours, so the artist had to design a palette for each screen. However, the palette of 32 colours could be changed at any point on the screen, so the menu icons on the bottom had their own set of 32 colours. The arcade section could only use 16 colours as the shadow effect used a bitplane trick, with half the palette being a dimmed version of the other half.'[Source:Andrew Bailey(coder), via his website]

drakkhen.name: Drakkhen
drakkhen.cheats:
Boot up disk 2 to create new characters. When you are asked for the first name while creating a member, type “SUPERVISOR” and press ‘RETURN’. Now enter a normal name for the character and continue the creation process. When you use this team of characters, the game works as usual except that when you press ‘F10’, all wounds are healed and dead characters are resurrected.
Or you can also do the following:
Boot up disk 2 to create new characters. When you are asked for the first name while creating the first character, type “31415927” and press ‘RETURN’. Then enter a normal name for the character. This will give all your characters higher attributes.
Both cheats may be activated. Just enter “31415927” and press ‘RETURN’. Next enter “SUPERVISOR” and press ‘RETURN’. Then enter a normal name for the character.
All armor, treasure and weapons inside palaces are restocked every time you enter. Send the strongest character in to grab the equipment, then distribute it amoung your band. If you need some quick gold, do this repeatedly, then go see the weaponsmith.
Get all the expirence points you want by going to Prince Haagkens castle. Make your way past the bats, past the first fireplace with the trap to the second fireplace. In front of the fireplace is a switch that activates a door two or three rooms farther on in the castle when you step on it. This door leads to a water fountain. Looking into the fountain transports you to a room filled with water that has a never ending supply of water monsters. Take your best weapon and armour with you. Set your character on ‘auto kill’ and if he or she is able to hang in there, you can leave the character in the room for several hours or all night killing off zillions of monsters. Do this for each of your characters and you’ll easily be able to kill the giant dragon.

given at the start (let’s say you chose amber).
2. Create five new characters, of any race or type. Make sure that
all five people have at least 130 gold pieces.
3. Go to the weapon shop, and pool all the gold, giving it to
amber.

amber.

start of the game. You can now start your quest with somewhere
in the region of 1000 gold pieces - unless you kit everyone up
at the weapon store, train,etc.You can repeat this as many
times as you want each go, giving you in effect infinite money.

dylan-dog-06-maelstrom.cheats:
SOLUTION DYLAN DOG N. 6 - MAELSTROM-------------------------------------------------
Dear diabolical keyboard-maniacs and dear lovers of the joystick, once again this month this page is dedicated to the students who haven’t studied properly.
Have you encountered the mummy? If so, you must be very respectful toward her and she will give you an amulet and put you into a deep sleep.
ARCADE:----------
Dylan will wake up in a dark and hostile forest. He must head toward position no. 1 and, along the way, he will meet an apparently crazy old man who will try to hide. Dylan must listen carefully and not call him crazy — in return, he will provide valuable information. The old man will then vanish as mysteriously as he appeared.
When you reach position no. 1, you must interact with the witch crucified upside down, and you will receive information on how to meet Kim (the beautiful rat-girl met in Dylan Dog no. 4). The witch will then die.
Now go to position no. 2. Dylan will find himself in front of a spooky-looking house; click on the house and you will gain access inside.
ARCADE:----------
Now head to position no. 3 where you will find a strange painting; click on the lowest image and head to position no. 4 where, in order to access position no. 5, you must interact with the organ until it works.
At this point the gate will open and Dylan must go in until he finds Kim in chains. Dylan must talk to her to get the necessary information to free her. Run to position no. 6 to stop the ritual for the arrival of the god Seth. You must use the amulet on the priest.
Once the priest is killed, the fabulous Kim will arrive and reward you for your efforts.
See you next time and...
...watch out for the Antichrist!

dynamic-debugger.name: Dynamic Debugger
dynamic-debugger.description: [1] DYNAMIC DEBUGGER, scheduled for release in 1989, was to have been the first moving HAM mode platform game on the Amiga, which would have displayed more than 4000 colours on screen at once.[2] The object of the game was to control Shaggle Waggle, the licenced dynamic debugger, and kill 10 levels of pests. Some of the weapons included a cork-firing champagne bottle, a vacuum cleaner, a DDT gun and a battery.[3] The general consensus of the few computer magazines who saw a preview version of the game was that the only thing going for it was the 4096 colours graphics exhibited in HAM mode![4] According toCathy CamposatMirrorsoft, DYNAMIC DEBUGGER was never released on the Amiga because the main coders were unable to produce a playable game after several months and further development was not financially viable. Similarly, it would never see release on any of the other platforms it was planned for either [Source:CU Amiga article, Nov 91, pp72-73].[5] Previews of DYNAMIC DEBUGGER appeared in several magazines:-Amiga Format (Issue 1, Aug 89, p10)-Amiga Computing (Vol. 2 No. 3, Aug 89, p18)-The Games Machine (Issue 21, Aug 89, pp8-9)-CU Amiga (Nov 91, pp72-73)-Amiga Power (Issue 18, Oct 92, pp91-96)

sphericule-ocs.name: E-Motion / Game Of Harmony, The (OCS)
sphericule-ocs.description: [1]Game concept & designby John Dale and The Assembly Line team.Codingby Adrian Stephens.Graphicsby The Assembly Line; additional artwork by Nick Pavis (Blue Turtle).Musicby John Dale and Adrian Stephens; sound FX by John Dale.[2] Released in the U.S. asTHE GAME OF HARMONYand elsewhere asE-MOTION.TRIVIA:Game designerJohn Daletook inspiration from the classic arcade gamesASTEROIDSandJOUSTin coming up with the concept for THE GAME OF HARMONY (aka E-MOTION). In a 1990 interview he explained the thought processes behind his conception of the game:"My job is to have ideas - I just sit around and have them. There was a little bit of thinking about the fact that there haven't been many games which use the 'Asteroids' type motion. You know: rotate and thrust. But at the same time we thought: 'What can we do that's different to Asteroids?' We had the idea for the ship that rotates and moves and then we thought: 'Well what's it going to do if it's not going to shoot things? Let's try pushing things around and see what we can do.' And we did.""You push two different coloured ones together and they become a pod.... that's an idea from Joust (an ageing Williams arcade game, which unfortunately only ever made it onto the ST, and even then not very accurately). You know, when you kill a bird it drops an egg? Well, if you don't get the egg it hatches out into another bird. So we kind of 'borrowed' that idea, in as much as you generate pods, and if you don't get the pods they grow into full size balls again. So the idea just got built up, really."[Source:The Assembly Line interview, The One for 16-bit Games (Issue 18, Mar 90, p44);courtesy of theAmiga Magazine Rack].

In a 1990 interview he explained the thought processes behind his conception of the game:"My job is to have ideas - I just sit around and have them. There was a little bit of thinking about the fact that there haven't been many games which use the 'Asteroids' type motion. You know: rotate and thrust. But at the same time we thought: 'What can we do that's different to Asteroids?' We had the idea for the ship that rotates and moves and then we thought: 'Well what's it going to do if it's not going to shoot things? Let's try pushing things around and see what we can do.' And we did.""You push two different coloured ones together and they become a pod.... that's an idea from Joust (an ageing Williams arcade game, which unfortunately only ever made it onto the ST, and even then not very accurately). You know, when you kill a bird it drops an egg? Well, if you don't get the egg it hatches out into another bird. So we kind of 'borrowed' that idea, in as much as you generate pods, and if you don't get the pods they grow into full size balls again. So the idea just got built up, really."[Source:The Assembly Line interview, The One for 16-bit Games (Issue 18, Mar 90, p44);courtesy of theAmiga Magazine Rack].
sphericule-ecs-ocs.cheats:
When the picture of Einstein appears the second time, type “MOONUNIT” and press ‘RETURN’. Now use the following keys during play:
‘F1’______________________Forward a level.
‘F2’_________________________Back a level.
‘F3’___________________Forward ten levels.
‘F4’______________________Back ten levels.
There are five ways you can complete a level and gain a hidden bonus:
- Finish a level with the last digit of the timer as a three.
- Complete a level collecting exactly 4 pods.
- Completely fail a bonus level by doing everything wrong.
- Complete a screen without wrapping around the screen.
- Finish a level without rotating your ship right (clockwise).

Sherlock was quite unimpressed with Costas' unfinished code and apparently rewrote much of it. Sherlock was so riled by the situation that he left Costas out of the coding credits and wrote the following message about him inside a file contained on disk 1 of the game:'It must be said that Richard Costas was the original programmer along with Toby, on this project, but because Ricky walked out, and I took over from him, rewriting a lot of his shit and badly written, unproffesional and ridiculously long winded code, and the fact that this was only half finished, I have decided not to include this fat git in the credits for this game, signed Jez. I will credit Richard Costas with the blame for a lot of hassle, stress, late nights and my hatred for the twat!'[2] Distributed in Germany by Rushware and in Italy by Leader.

empire-soccer-94-ecs-ocs.cheats:
Select the ten minute game and hold down the fire button at all times (even when your player gets the ball). Stop running but keep the fire button pressed. The opposition will immediately slide tackle you.
This will almost always cause them to get fouled. They will be given a yellow card (and eventually a red one) and eventually be sent off
the field. Continue this until there is only three players left on
the opposing team (the goalie and two field men). You might be able to get more players fouled out, but it may be hard. You should now
have all you players and will be able to run circles around the
opposing team.

PublisherTitanscheduled the game for release in 1998/99, but reportedly didn't publish it because there were too many bugs in the last beta version they received from the developers (e.g. inability to open doors because keys do not exist).One major bug in particular, where the final enemy is rendered immortal and the game impossible to complete, no doubt dealt the fatal knockout blow to the game's chances of being published following the developer's departure from the ailing Amiga market. Moreover, the game was written in 100% assembly language (ASM), which apparently was not conducive to the graphics card support originally promised byTitan. [Source:Titan, via email withLuca Giudice][3] Features of the final release of EVIL'S DOOM SE were to include:- hand-drawn graphics, stunning soundtrack- dozens of characters and locations- full motion video (FMV) animation sequences- complete English/German digitised speech sequences- 256 colour hi-res graphics- AGA and gfx card support- new 3D engine for dungeons- German, English and French localisations[4]EVIL'S DOOM SE V1.1(playable demo)is available fordownloadonAminetHERE(dir: biz/titan/EvilsDoom_demo.lha).Min. Requirements (demo):AGA chipset, 68020 CPU, 2MB chipram/5MBb fastram, approx. 6MB HD space.[5]EVIL'S DOOM SE(video trailer)is also available fordownloadonAminetHERE.Min. Requirements (video trailer):AGA chipset, 68020 CPU, 1MB chip/5MB fastram, 100MB HD space.[6] Previews of EVIL'S DOOM SE appeared in the following magazines:- Amiga Active (Issue 2, Nov 99, p46)- Amiga Survivor (Issue 7, June 99, p12)

Released as the game was perceived as being too hard, the discovery disk was described as a 'pricey tips selection' in Amiga Format no. 87.Press F10 to swtich between laguages.

exodus-the-last-war.name: Exodus: The Last War
exodus-the-last-war.description: [1]Game design & codingby Andrzej Bugajny.Graphics & animationby Mariusz Samson.Musicby Micha? Jesionowski.Textby Tomasz Witt.[2]Requirements:68030+ CPU, 1.5Mb chipram, 16mb fastram (or 17Mb for gfx card), AGA/gfx card (CyberGraphX 3.0+ support only), 4x CDROM, HDRecommended:68040+ CPU, 32mb fastram, 8x CDROM[3] Game features 3D sound, gfx card support and a 2-player mode via null-modem cable.Last known release:V2.1

exolon.name: Exolon
exolon.cheats:

explora-iii-sous-le-signe-du-serpent.description: Title English translation: UNDER THE SIGN OF THE SERPENT.Distributed in France by Ciep.

chrono-quest-ii-ocs.description: English version released asCHRONO QUEST II.Original french version distributed by 16 32 Diffusion (Source:https://www.abandonware-france.org/compagnies/16-32-diffusion-1499/), published by Infomedia.

extase.description: [1]Game designby Rémi Herbulot and Philippe Ulrich.Codingby Patrick Dublanchet.Graphicsby Michel Rho.Musicby Philippe Eidel, Arnaud Devos and The Bulgarian Voices choir; remix by Rémi Herbulot; and sound FX by Stéphane Picq.[2] Marketed/distributed worldwide (except France) byVirgin Mastertronic.[3] Game features mouse/keyboard/joystick control.

Type ‘3976’ as a levelcode, you will now enter the Mystic Crisis
level.

exterminator.name: Exterminator
exterminator.description: [1] Audiogenic planned its own unofficial sequelEXTERMINATOR 2, but it was never released.[2] Distributed in Germany byBomicoand in France byUbisoft.TRIVIA:This was the only licensed arcade conversion that Audiogenic ever published.

exterminator-2.name: Exterminator 2
exterminator-2.description: [1] An unofficial sequel planned by Audiogenic that was tentatively scheduled for release in 1992. It was to take the basic design ofEXTERMINATORand add new insects, hazards, bonus levels and hidden rooms. Given that development of this sequel was partly dependent on successful sales of the original, it is possible that the game never reached legitimate design or development phases.[2] News of this game was reported in CU Amiga (Mar 91, p9) and Amiga Power (Issue 1, May 91, p12).

extractors-the-hanging-worlds-of-zarg.name: Extractors: The Hanging Worlds Of Zarg
extractors-the-hanging-worlds-of-zarg.description: Reviewed in Amiga Power issue 50, page 36

extreme-violence.name: Extreme Violence
extreme-violence.description: [1] Written inAMOS.Game design & codingby Simon Green.[2]Min. Requirements:1MB ram (incl. ~400k free chipram) or more.[3] Game supports joystick/keyboard control, PAL/NTSC screenmodes and multitasking (memory permitting).[4] Theregistered versionof EXTREME VIOLENCE features better power-ups, including seeking missiles, turning missiles, teleports and much more, over and above theshareware demo. Theregistered versionalso contains separate executable files for 1- and 2-player games, while theshareware demois limited to 2-player gameplay only.[5] ***EXTREME VIOLENCE(full shareware release)*** is available fordownloadfrom these sources:-EXTREME VIOLENCE V7.23(HD version)[Source: EAB FTP site]-EXTREME VIOLENCE V7.23(HD version)[Source:Amigan Softwarewebpage]-EXTREME VIOLENCE V7.23(unofficial WHDLoad HD version)[Source: EAB FTP site]-EXTREME VIOLENCE V7.23(HD version / Amiga Power Game Massive CD Vol. 1)[Source: EAB FTP site]-EXTREME VIOLENCE V7.23(HD version / Amiga Power Game Massive CD Vol. 1)[Source:Internet Archive]Known releases:- V6.9 (Jan-93)- V6.92 (May-93)- V7.23 (22-Mar-95) [full registered version as released on theAmiga Power 49 (May 95) coverCD—downloadAmiga Power Game Massive CD Vol. 1 eitherHEREorHERE]TRIVIA:In contrast to later demo/registered versions of the game,EXTREME VIOLENCE V6.9includes two bonus music mods by coderSimon Greenfor independent playback. The first mod is a catchy techno remix ofKim Carnes'1981 Grammy Award winning hit "Bette Davis Eyes", while the other is an original rave noise track containing "The Eagle has landed" samples from theApollo 11first manned moon landing in 1969.
extreme-violence.cheats:
On the title screen, type one of the following and then press ‘RETURN’ for even more *extreme* fun in one or two-player mode:
“DUNE”_________For magic laser (penetrates walls), speedy boots and keeping weapons when you die; press ‘HELP’ for funny map
“TERMINATOR”_____________________________For ECM for both players
“LAWNMOWER”____________________For bouncy bullets (rebound off walls) [no bounces limit], speedy boots and keeping weapons when you die; press ‘HELP’ for funny map
A voice will say "Bingo!" if you have entered the cheat correctly. Don’t forget to press ‘RETURN’ after you enter any of the above.
These cheats should work on all versions of the game released too. Again, type one of the following on the title screen and then press ‘RETURN’:“GIGER”_________For speedy boots and fast seeking lasers (no range limit)
“DALI”___________________________For speedy boots and fast turning lasers (no turns limit)
“ESCHER”__________________For speedy boots and two choice power-ups on every levelFinally, if you think the one player version (contained in the registered version only) is too easy, try typing "HARD" or "INSANE" on the title screen.[Source:Simon Green(coder), as supplied in the game docs ofEXTREME VIOLENCEV7.23(full shareware release)]

eye.name: Eye
eye.description: [1] Licensed game. Fingers Products’ board game was conceived by Australian teacher Kerry Sevill; German fashion student, Iris Lüttring; & Irish ex-jockey, Billy Barry. Included is a cardboard cut-out of the board & an offer to buy 'Eye- The Official Gamebook'.[2] Distributed in Germany by Ariolasoft.

the-eye-of-horus.name: Eye Of Horus, The
the-eye-of-horus.description: [1] After the copy protection screen and when it says to press fire, type "PANTHER" for a simple demo from the developers. You will need to restart the game in order exit the demo.[2] Distributed in Germany by Ariolasoft.
the-eye-of-horus.cheats: After you type in the copy protection and it says to press fire, type “SPAM” instead. The game will start, and you’ll have infinite lives and you won’t need any of the keys.

eye-of-the-beholder-ecs-ocs.name: Eye Of The Beholder (ECS / OCS)
eye-of-the-beholder-ecs-ocs.description: [1] EYE OF THE BEHOLDER is a licensed game based on theAD&D® 2nd editiongame rules, and the first installment in SSI's "Legend Series" of games.[2] Original game contents include a map of sewer levels 1-3 (seeHERE).[3] Game supports a quit back to WB option.
eye-of-the-beholder-ecs-ocs.cheats:
Make two copies of disk 2 then make up your parties on both disks.
Play the game as usual, but when you find any secret passages or
walls, or unlock any doors, insert the other disk and continue playing for a short while. This passes all the data onto this disk. Replace the original disk and continue playing and now, if you get stuck in
the game and you have to start again, simply continue with the other disk and all the doors that were previously locked will be open.
Plus, you’ll be able to pick up the keys that you needed to unlock
them as a bonus!

eye-of-the-beholder-aga.name: Eye Of The Beholder (AGA)
eye-of-the-beholder-aga.description: [1] This is a modified version of Eye of the Beholder that runs with 256 colour AGA graphics, supports multi-languages and includes an auto-mapper cheat.[2] See http://eob.wikispaces.com/EOB1+AGA+GAME for more information and download.

eye-of-the-beholder-ii-the-legend-of-dar.name: Eye Of The Beholder II: The Legend Of Darkmoon / Eye Of The Beholder II: Legende Von Darkmoon (ECS / OCS)
eye-of-the-beholder-ii-the-legend-of-dar.cheats:
1. Load the game as normal and select “CREATE NEW PARTY”. When the
empty boxes appear, click on the top left box, then select race,
class, alignment and portrait. Now go to the modify box and
boost all the statistics in this order: STRENGTH, INTELLIGENCE,
WISDOM, DEXTERITY, CONSTITUTION, CHARISMA, AND HIT POINTS. Now
you can click on strength and boost it to maximum, regardless of
limitation put on the race or class of the character, so from
now on, for example, you can have a super-hard wizard with a
strength of 18/99.
2. At the character generation screen, always increase all stats
that you can (that includes hit points) to as high as they will
go.
3. If you want a mage, cleric or paladin to use a two handed
weapon as well as magic, then do the following. Put the weapon
down on the ground, and their spellbook or magic symbol in their
second hand. Click the right mouse button on this for a list of
spells to appear. Pick up the two handed weapon and place it in
the characters primary hand. As the list of spells is still up,
they can now cast spells and use a two handed weapon at the same
time. You will have to repeat this process after using the
compassetc.
On the wasp level, stand on the spot where the two rooms join (the room to the south which has a crack in the wall - the hornet’s nest) and rest. This should generate four wasps which can be killed easily to gain experience points.

eye-of-the-beholder-ii-the-legend-of-dar.name: Eye Of The Beholder II: The Legend Of Darkmoon / Eye Of The Beholder II: Legende Von Darkmoon (AGA)
eye-of-the-beholder-ii-the-legend-of-dar.description: This is a modified version of Eye of the Beholder 2 that runs with 256 colour AGA graphics, supports multi-language and includes an auto-mapper cheat.

eye-of-the-storm.name: Eye Of The Storm
eye-of-the-storm.description: [1] Game design, gfx & visual effects by Jason Kingsley. Code by Alister Perrott; additional code & visual effects by Paul Gomm.[2] Game supports a quit back to WB option.[3] Originally scheduled for release in late '91 byEmpire, the game was eventually released (after much delay for reasons unknown) in 1994 byRebellion(i.e. coder Jason Kingsley's own publishing label).[4] The game is freely available for downloadHERE[Source:Ami Sector One].

f-15-strike-eagle.name: F-15 Strike Eagle
f-15-strike-eagle.description: Referenced in Amiga Power's 'Every Amiga Game Ever Guide'

f-15-strike-eagle-ii.name: F-15 Strike Eagle II
f-15-strike-eagle-ii.description: [1] While the game is in English, the manual protection screen is multilingual (English, French, German).[2] Distributed in Germany by Rushware.Known releases:10-Jun-91 (EU), 13-Jun-91 (US).
f-15-strike-eagle-ii.cheats:
During play, press ‘CTRL’, ‘ALT’, and ‘R’ simutaneously to restock
your ammunition.

f-16-combat-pilot.name: F-16 Combat Pilot
f-16-combat-pilot.description: [1] Game supports a multiplayer, cross-platform option for dogfighting against a human opponent via null-modem (Amiga to Amiga or Amiga to Atari ST only).[2] A multilanguage manual (English, French, German) for F-16 COMBAT PILOT is contained in-game, but English is the only language used in the game otherwise.[3] Distributed in Germany byRushwareand in Italy byLeader.
f-16-combat-pilot.cheats: If you’re fed up with landing try the following: Jetison all fuel and weapons and climb to 65000ft. Stay there until the last of your fuel runs out. Dive towards the ground and at 10 or 11 thousand feet pull up hard. You will then be able to rise about 4000 ft and then start falling towards the ground. Just as you hit the ground the mission will end safely.

f-19-stealth-fighter.name: F-19 Stealth Fighter
f-19-stealth-fighter.description: [1] The U.S. version of F-19 STEALTH FIGHTER was released on 3 disks (cf. 2 disks for the UK release).[2] Distributed in Germany by Rushware and in Italy by Leader.Known releases:- V1.00 (1990)[UK], V1.00 (27-Feb-91)[UK]- V1.00 (28-Jan-91)[U.S.]TRIVIA:Originally released in 1987 on 8-bit platforms (C64/128, Spectrum) asPROJECT: STEALTH FIGHTER, there was heavy speculation from media and other sources surrounding a missing aircraft in theU.S. Air Force'snumbering system, theF-19. It was speculated that theF-19was theU.S. Air Force'snew "stealth bomber", which was widely rumoured at the time to be undetectable by radar due to its innovative design.MicroProse, through unclassified info. gleaned by retired U.S. Air Force pilot and then-presidentMajor "Wild Bill" Stealeyand from various other sources, producedPROJECT: STEALTH FIGHTER......the first stealth flight simulator, based on a number of educated guesses about what the new "stealth fighter" would be like when released. TheF-19remained hypothetical, however, and no such aircraft bearing the moniker was ever unveiled by theU.S. Air Force.In November 1988, theU.S. Air Forcefinally unveiled their new stealth fighter as theF-117 Nighthawk. Shortly afterwardsMicroProsereleased F-19 STEALTH FIGHTER for PC, the first enhanced 16-bit version ofPROJECT: STEALTH FIGHTER. The 16-bit versions of the game - including the Amiga/Atari ST releases in 1990 - incorporated the real-lifeF-117 Nighthawk, as well asMicroProse'shypothetical F-19 Stealth Fighter.
f-19-stealth-fighter.cheats:
Press ‘ALT’ and ‘H’ to get the pitch lines on your HUD, fly upside down, turn off your engines, keep your plane about 10 degrees on your hud and watch that baby climb.
For practically all missions, carry as many Mavericks as possible, along with some Sidewinders for maximum massacre capability. Also, if the enemy are giving you a hard time, land near a runway and taxi to the edge of it (but not onto it), then shut down your engines and wait. Bizarrely, this will cause the enemy to get bored and clear off.

f-a-18-interceptor.name: F/A-18 Interceptor
f-a-18-interceptor.description: [1]Min. Requirements:512k ram (disconnect any external floppy drives for enhanced sound).Recommended:1MB ram or more (for enhanced sound and the ability to view the demo flight in full), colour monitor.[2] Game supports joystick/keyboard control.[3] More about the development of F/A-18 INTERCEPTOR can be read in a 2004 interview with game designer/coderBob DinnermanHERE. [Source:Tom Steinberg's Personal Blog][4] Distributed in Germany by Rushware and in Italy by C.T.O.TRIVIA:Extra memory (1MB ram or more) provides players with a title tune inspired by the soundtrack from popular 1980s action movie "Top Gun". According to a 2004interview, game designer/coderBob Dinnermanspecifically asked musicianDave Warholto compose a score for the game that generated the same atmosphere as the soundtrack crafted for "Top Gun" did (seeHERE). [Source:Tom Steinberg's Personal Blog]
f-a-18-interceptor.cheats:
Taxi down U.S. 101, turn right at highway 92, pull up to the EA headquarters and blow it away!
In mission 6, once you’ve fired all your missiles, you can land on the shadow sub (if it’s still afloat) and it will refuel and rearm you.
For extra missions select free flight and then press ‘6’, ‘7’, ‘8’, or ‘9’ to enter the mission.
Select option 2 {FREE FLIGHT, NO ENEMY CONFRONTATION} from the main menu. Then select zero instead of 1 to 4. The screen will go into a spiral and scroll way south to 34 by 117 degrees, placing your plane somewhere without a runway. This happens to be in the middle of Edwards air force base, where the F/A-18 was flight tested. To take off you have to use the afterburners. 117 degrees is the furthest south you’ll be able to fly, but you can go in other directions. Is there more to this back door?

f1-licenceware-cd-rom-volume-one.name: F1 Licenceware CD-Rom Volume One F1-001 To F1-100
f1-licenceware-cd-rom-volume-one.description: This CD includes all games, educational titles and other applications from F1 Licenceware series No. 001 - 103.

f1-tornado.name: F1 Tornado
f1-tornado.description: Codingby Glyn Humphreys and Andrew Nixon.Vector graphicsby Glyn Humphreys; additional graphics by Neil Hislop.Musicby Stuart Taylor; sound FX by David Taylor.

f1-world-championship-edition.name: F1 World Championship Edition
f1-world-championship-edition.description: Magazine publisher: Amiga Power no. 62, Jun 1996.
f1-world-championship-edition.cheats: On the title screen, Type “REVEAL”. The screen should flash red.

f17-challenge.name: F17 Challenge
f17-challenge.description: Originally to have been called F1 Challenge, the game was renamed to F17 Challenge after a legal wrangle with Fuji and the FIA. They had demanded a huge sum of money claiming that using the letters 'F' and '1' together in a title (or the words 'Grand' and 'Prix' for that matter) infringed their copyrights. Team 17 changed the title instead.
f17-challenge.cheats: When you reach a tunnel crash against the left wall and hold the joystick there until you reach 100 percent damage. Then hold down the fire button and your damage will go up to about 700 percent and reset back to 0 percent. Make sure you are well inside the tunnel or you will reach daylight halfway through the cheat.

f29-retaliator.name: F29 Retaliator
f29-retaliator.description: [1] TheUK/Euro releasesof F29 RETALIATOR comprised two disks, while theU.S. releasewas condensed to one disk (seeDiskscan).[2] Game supports joystick/mouse/keyboard control.[3] Distributed byEAin the U.S.,Bomicoin Germany, andLeaderin Italy.[4] An earlier version of the game exists with different graphics for some screens. It seems that this version contained bugs and was replaced with the version shown in the DBS.
f29-retaliator.cheats:
On the enrollment enter your name as “CIARAN” then load up the pilots log. THE NAME SHOULD NOW READ {OCEAN OK}. NOW You can fly any mission with the huge benefit of infinite missiles and cannons.
Also, choose “THE DIDDY MEN” for your name, click {COLONEL} icon and hit ‘RETURN’. Accept a mission (without selecting one) then go back and select a mission. Now start the game and play as normal. Hit ‘ENTER’ to automatically land the plane.

f29-retaliator-special-mission.name: F29 Retaliator Special Mission
f29-retaliator-special-mission.description: This mission is on the coverdisk fromZero, issue 12, October 1990. Disk is a dual format Amiga/ST disk which also contains a Battle Command demo.

fables-and-fiends-book-one-the-legend-of.name: Fables & Fiends: Book One - The Legend Of Kyrandia
fables-and-fiends-book-one-the-legend-of.description: [1] Min. Requirements - 1Mb ram and Kickstart 1.2.[2] English and German language versions were released separately (see Boxscans).[3] This was the first installment in The Legend of Kyrandia games trilogy and, unfortunately, was the only one converted for the Amiga.

face-off-anco.name: Face Off (Anco)
face-off-anco.publisher: 16 Bit Pocket Power Collection, The (Prism Leisure)

face-off-krisalis.name: Face-Off (Krisalis)
face-off-krisalis.description: Distributed in Germany by Bomico and in Italy by Softel.

the-faery-tale-adventure.name: Faery Tale Adventure, The
the-faery-tale-adventure.description: Hereafter the 10 questions / answers from questionary :Need You'll more than...? MIGHTTo Quest for the...? LIGHTMake haste, but take...? HEEDScorn murderous...? DEEDSummon the...? SIGHTWing forth in...? FLIGHTHold fast to your...? CREEDFrom Illusion be...? FREEDDefy Ye that...? BLIGHTIn black darker than...? NIGHT
the-faery-tale-adventure.cheats:
Save your position in the dungeons or caves. The go through it and open doors until you run out of keys. Now restore your position, and you will have all your keys, but all the doors will still be open. Repeat as often as you need.
Go to the dark evil castle. Stand right up against the force field. Let yourself starve so that you faint. When you wake up, you’ll be on the other side of the forcefield.
Find the green turtle, jump on his back and start attacking. Nothing will happen except your bravery points will keep piling up.
On the island with the Crystal Castle press RIGHT MOUSE BUTTON while speaking with the sorceress and luck increases to 65. Ask the sorceress several times.
A secret entrance to the fort exists. On the left side, near even with the door.
If running low on Green keys, use a secret entrance for the fort. It’s on the left side, almost even with the door.
Beating the Turtle is not beating, it is pushing, so push the turtle across the land, to use it in special places: The turtle was programmed in asbestos, and can swim in Lava. It can be used to enter the black citadel at the south. Also, while it is present, you are not attacked, but by the time one has the turtle, one is already invincible.
Save a game to a back up file and patch byte 18 to a non-zero value and you know have these cheats at your disposal:
ARROW KEYS____Move very fast over any terrain. ‘B’__________________________Summon gold swan. ‘R’___________________________Rescue princess. ‘=‘_______________________Display coordinates. ‘F9’________________Increase time by one hour. ‘F10’_________________Location in coordinates.

falcon-ocs.name: Falcon (OCS)
falcon-ocs.description: [1]Min. Requirements:KS 1.2 or above, 512k ram.Recommended:1MB ram or more (to enable the black box feature and for additional enhanced graphics & sound).[2]Game supports keyboard/joystick-keyboard/mouse-keyboard controland features both dial-up and null-modem support for two player dogfights, within and across platforms (Amiga/Atari ST/PC).[3] Distributed in Germany by Ariolasoft.Known releases:V1.00 (1989), V1.1 (1989)
falcon-ocs.cheats:
If your ammo runs low, press ‘CTRL’ and ‘X’ during the game and watch the extra 500 rounds and 9 sidewinders clock up on the instruments. It maybe ‘CTRL’, ‘L SHIFT’, and ‘X’. For a perfect landing, hold the ‘HELP’ key down about 10 to 20 feet above the runway.
If you get badly hit, don’t bail out, instead swing round and head for home. Press ‘HELP’ and the ‘+’ on the keypad and keep them depressed. The F16 will stay level and drop down. Switch to tracking mode and rotate to side view. Just before touch down, pitch up the nose and the plane will touch down successfully every time. Select “end mission” and you will be rescued even if you are in enemy territory.

falcon-cdtv.name: Falcon (CDTV)
falcon-cdtv.description: [1]Original game concept & designby Gilman "Chopstick" Louie and Mark Johnson; operation missions concept & design by Rod Hyde and David Whiteside.CDTV codingby Chris Orton, Colin Bell and David Whiteside; additional coding from original game by Russell Payne.CDTV graphicsby David Whiteside and Mark Shaw; original game gfx by Martin Kenwright; 3D graphics by Martin Kenwright and David Whiteside.Sound FXby Russell Payne and Andy Fisher; vocal sound production by Richard Joseph with voices by Adam Henderson, Greg Charles and James O'Donnell.Compressionby Jim Taylor.[2] The CDTV release of FALCON contains both theOPERATION COUNTERSTRIKEandOPERATION FIREFIGHTmissions that were sold separately on disk for the initial floppy release of the game. Additionally, it incorporates an updated build of the game contained in the floppy release, including enhanced audio and loads of CDXL sequences & speech (the latter both in the intro and the game itself).[3] Distributed in Australia byOzi Soft.Last known release:V1.4 M1.0 (04-Nov-91)

falcon-mission-disk-operation-counterstr.name: Falcon Mission Disk - Operation: Counterstrike
falcon-mission-disk-operation-counterstr.description: [1]Game design & conceptby Gilman Louie and Mark Johnson.Codingby Chris Orton, Colin Bell and Russell Payne.Graphicsby Martin Kenwright; 3D graphics by David Whiteside and Martin Kenwright.Sound FXby Russell Payne and Andy Fisher.[2]Min. Requirements:KS 1.2 or above, 512k ram.Recommended:1MB ram or more (to enable the black box feature and for additional enhanced graphics & sound).[3] FALCON MISSION DISK - OPERATION: COUNTERSTRIKE requires the insertion of disk 2 of the original release ofFALCONafter booting.[4] FALCON MISSION DISK VOL. 1 contains an updated F16 combat plane and includes one or two small bugfixes to make landings easier than in the original game. More importantly, however, the mission disk transforms the original release ofFALCONfrom a training simulator into a miltary simulator, containing a series of interconnected missions that represent a full scale air and ground offensive by the enemy against your home base.[5]Game supports keyboard/joystick-keyboard/mouse-keyboard controland features both dial-up and null-modem support for two player dogfights, within and across platforms (Amiga/Atari ST).

falcon-mission-disk-volume-ii-operation-.name: Falcon Mission Disk Volume II: Operation Firefight

famous-five-the-five-on-a-treasure-islan.name: Famous Five, The: Five On A Treasure Island
famous-five-the-five-on-a-treasure-islan.description: [1] Licensed game based onEnid Blyton'spopular children's book "Five on a Treasure Island", published in 1942.[2]Game designby Colin Jordan.Codingby Nick Byron.Graphicsby Michael Hanrahan.[3] Game features ramload/ramsave (for storing the current game state in memory) and savegame support.

Fantabulous.name: Fantabulous
Fantabulous.description: One of the rarest earlier compilation published by Ubi Soft for Amiga. This compilation had no advertisement in any french magazines, i found it by luck. It shows that Ubi Soft was in fact flushing their replacement disks and manuals in this type of compilation. Each game has its manual from the original publisher, there is no ubi soft manual.

fantastic-dizzy-ecs-ocs.name: Fantastic Dizzy (ECS / OCS)
fantastic-dizzy-ecs-ocs.description: This Christmas-themed demo version of Fantastic Dizzy was on the coverdisk ofAmiga Power issue 33, disk A.
fantastic-dizzy-ecs-ocs.cheats:
On the title screen, hold down ‘L SHIFT’, ‘S’, ‘U’, and ‘B’. You will
then be presented with a new menu called “Subgame Cheat Thing” where
you can pick from 6 subgames:
Puzzle Hole
Puzzle Swap
Bubble
Minecart
Archery
Zaks Tower
Once you exit the this menu the game will start. Press ‘F10’ to
automatically gain 6 lives.

fantastic-island.name: Fantastic Island
fantastic-island.description: "HD Failure - All Data Lost ! :(" - Mutation Software. A titlescreen can be seen at the end of Cyberpunks.

fantastic-voyage-ecs-ocs.name: Fantastic Voyage (ECS / OCS)
fantastic-voyage-ecs-ocs.description: [1] Based on the film "Fantastic Voyage" from 1966[2] Technical specs of the game :o Assembly Code developed with DevTop 1.8 on an A2500o Gfx created using DPaint 3 on an A3000o Music composed and arranged using a Roland D-50, U-110, Korg Juno 2 & a DW-8000.o Total Level Size: 200 screenso Gfx Data: 2.5 Megso # of Anim. Frames: 630 frameso Music Score: 700 Ko Music Duration: 23 minuteso Sample Rate: 20 KHzo Screen Refreshrate: 60 Hz (NTSC), 50 Hz (PAL)o Max # of Blitterobjects: 48o # of Fadesteps: 166o ScanLoad Transfer Rate: >30000 bytes/seco Project Duration: 9 months
fantastic-voyage-ecs-ocs.cheats:
On the title screen, press fire to start the game. When you are
asked to enter disk two, enter the second disk. After you insert the 2nd disk the drive light should go on for a second and then
off. Now quickly press and hold the LEFT and RIGHT MOUSE BUTTONS, the FIRE BUTTON, and the ‘SPACE BAR’. Hold them until the drive
light goes out again. You should now be at the control room
screen. Press fire to start and you will now start with 99 lives.

Advancement in rank has nothing to do with the amount of credits to your name. It is releated to the number of missions you complete and ships destroyed. The only way to earn a lot of credits is to haggle on the trade-net. By staying in the space station on the net, and trading in guns, food and gold, you will quickly build a fortune. Travelling to space stations requires you to jump until you cannot get any further. Guide to completing the missions:

Use E pod.

destination.
